{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000067754N0V1E7Y9","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group build "dxos: build and publish" {
  node Config "dx.config.ts" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/vite-plugin/composer/index.ts"
  node Builder "PluginBuilder" ref="packages/core/compute/plugin-builder/src/build-bundle.ts"
  node CLI "dx registry publish" ref="packages/devtools/cli"
}
group registry "edge: registry-service" {
  node Store "PluginStore"
  node Bundles "R2 bundles"
  node Index "D1 operation index"
}
group compute "edge: compute-service" {
  node Router "PluginRouter"
  node Loader "PluginLoader" ref="packages/core/compute/edge-compute/src/plugin-loader"
  node Host "PluginHost" ref="packages/core/compute/plugin-host-cloudflare"
}
node Browser "Composer (browser)"
node Caller "MCP, agent, trigger"
node DB "db-service (ECHO)"
edge Config -> Builder "vite build"
edge Builder -> CLI "bundle + vendor/"
edge CLI -> Store "upload"
edge Store owns Bundles
edge Store owns Index
edge Browser -> Bundles "load manifest"
edge Caller -> Router "invoke dxn:"
edge Router -> Index "resolve key"
edge Router -> Loader
edge Loader -> Bundles "read bundle"
edge Loader -> Host "Dynamic Worker"
edge Host -> DB "space via scope"
"},"objects":[
